cover_letter:
Dear Silverfin Hiring Team,

I am writing to convey my enthusiastic interest in the Temporary Full-Stack Web Developer role advertised. My career has focused on the intersection of technical web development, SEO, and content, a blend that aligns perfectly with your vision for the complete reconstruction of silverfin.com and enhancing Silverfin’s digital presence. I am particularly drawn to Silverfin’s commitment to innovation and supporting the accountancy profession through advanced technology.

My experience centers on full-stack development with a strong emphasis on WordPress, a key requirement for this role. I have personally designed, built, and maintained websites like baverok.com and majistraleczacilari.org.tr using WordPress and Elementor, ensuring accessible markup and optimal performance. My backend skills in PHP, combined with my proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and AngularJS, enable me to develop robust, responsive, and mobile-first interfaces that meet modern accessibility (WCAG) standards.

A core aspect of my work involves leveraging CMS platforms to empower content teams, a responsibility I have consistently fulfilled in previous roles through comprehensive content management and workflow documentation. I bring a proven track record in technical SEO audits, structured data implementation, and optimizing for both traditional and AI-powered search (AEO), as demonstrated by projects like mirook.com, which measurably improved search health scores. This expertise will be vital for implementing an effective 301 redirect strategy and driving measurable improvements in SEO rankings for the new silverfin.com. My experience also includes integrating analytics (Google Analytics, Google Search Console) to track performance and inform strategic decisions.

I approach web development with a strategic "get things done" mindset, always balancing immediate execution with long-term architectural scalability and a relentless focus on conversion and user experience. My ability to communicate complex technical choices clearly to non-technical stakeholders, coupled with my fluent English and proficiency in Dutch (B1 writing, A2+ speaking), will enable seamless collaboration with your marketing team and across global regions. I am excited by the opportunity to apply my skills to build a high-performance, multi-language digital ecosystem for Silverfin.

Thank you for considering my application. I have attached my CV for your review and welcome the opportunity to discuss how my technical and strategic web development experience can contribute significantly to Silverfin’s success.

Sincerely,

Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Extensive WordPress Expertise: Proven track record in designing, building, and maintaining robust WordPress sites, including custom themes and structured data, alongside comprehensive CMS content management for diverse client projects.
- Full-Stack & Front-End Development: Solid backend skills in PHP, with hands-on HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and AngularJS, focused on optimizing front-end features and creating responsive, mobile-first interfaces adhering to accessibility (WCAG) and performance standards.
- SEO, GEO, & AI Search Optimization: Expertise in technical SEO audits, keyword research, structured data (JSON-LD schema), and AEO (AI search visibility), driving measurable improvements in search health scores.
- CMS-Driven Architecture & Marketing Empowerment: Experience in configuring user-friendly CMS platforms (WordPress, Elementor) and empowering marketing teams through content management and documented workflows.
- Strategic Project Leadership & Analytics: Proven ability to manage website projects from conception to launch, implementing analytics and tracking for performance measurement, and communicating technical choices to non-technical stakeholders.
